package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestLearningWorkspaceRepositoryIsAtomicReadOnlySelectedPathProjection(t *testing.T) {
	contents, err := os.ReadFile("learning_workspace_repo_pg.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(contents)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{IsoLevel: pgx.RepeatableRead, AccessMode: pgx.ReadOnly})",
		"student_learning_context c", "p.id, p.student_id, p.course_id", "p.id=c.selected_learning_path_id", "p.student_id=c.student_id", "p.status='ACTIVE'", "c.selected_path_status='ACTIVE'",
		"loadLearningPathItems(ctx, tx", "tx.Commit(ctx)",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, required) {
			t.Fatalf("workspace projection is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	start := strings.Index(source, "func (repo *LearningJourneyRepoPG) ReadLearningWorkspace")
	if start < 0 {
		t.Fatal("workspace reader is missing")
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"INSERT INTO", "UPDATE ", "DELETE FROM", "student_outbox", "idempotency"} {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToUpper(source[start:]), strings.ToUpper(forbidden)) {
			t.Fatalf("workspace projection contains mutation marker %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
}
